## Change

What does this change, and why? Use a Conventional Commit title for the squash PR.

## Evidence

What did you run, against which version or commit and host? If applicable, distinguish the OMP adapter, packaged skill and standalone skill, and distinguish synthetic request or response fixtures from live model behavior. What did you observe, and what's still unverified? For teaching changes, show an original synthetic handoff and the distinct explanation; don't present it as actual model output or user research.

## Impact

Call out privacy, compatibility, and packaging changes, plus any needed approval. Link the affected docs. Do not include credentials, private reports, or raw transcripts. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately via `SECURITY.md`, not in a PR.

If this adds material, state its provenance and confirm you have permission to contribute it under this branch's GPL-3.0-only terms. For substantive external contributions, follow [the contribution policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-contributions) before starting work.
